text:
pm-alex: Hey team — FinSparc just escalated: sustained 95th pct latency spikes on /v1/generate for the last 20m, risk of hitting their SLA window. Can we get quick ownership and an ETA for mitigation? :warning:
eng-oncall: @pm-alex saw the alert, I'm on it. Oncall runbook step 1: confirm it's an infra or model issue. Pulling p95 by region now. :eyes:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] escalation: FINSPARC - Endpoint /v1/generate high p95 (1200ms) — triggered at 2026-03-17T10:12:00Z
sre-sasha: I can take triage for service-side. Can someone from runtime confirm if there's a recent rollout? last deploy looks like a model variant push ~30m ago.
ria-engr: I pushed a routing change 35m ago to route heavy requests to `redwood/llama-70b-qe` variant for cost tests — will revert if that's the source. Pinged infra-tom to check pool pressure.
infra-tom: Looking at GPU pool utilization — burst pools at 95% in us-east-1, some pods OOM/killed in the last 10m. Suspect autoscaler didn't trigger due to pending quota check. Opening quota ticket now but need a short-term workaround.
customer-success-liz: FinSparc says impact on checkout flows. They're asking for a temporary SLA allowance or a rollback. They're very sensitive to timeline (30-60m).
sre-sasha: Quick mitigation options: 1) Revert routing change to previous model variant (safe, ~10m). 2) Scale up dedicated pool (needs infra approval, ~45m). 3) Apply request-level rate-limiting for that customer (can push now but could cause failed requests). Which do we want?
pm-alex: Prioritize rollback to keep customer online. We can follow up with scaling. Owner?
ria-engr: I'll revert the routing change right now and watch metrics. Reverting to `redwood/llama-30b-v2` — doing `kubectl set env svc/inference ROUTE_VARIANT=llama-30b-v2 -n prod`. ETA 8m incl propagation.
julien: FYI I have a pending PR that changes KV cache eviction which could affect latency — not merged to prod yet. Skipping that for now. :+1:
sre-sasha: Recording action items: (A) @ria-engr revert (owner) (B) @infra-tom check autoscaler + quota (owner) (C) @julien hold PR until stable (owner) (D) @customer-success-liz keep FinSparc updated and request SLA for 1h grace.
infra-tom: Autoscaler logs show `scaleDownLimiter` prevented add due to recent scaleups; looks like bug in policy. I can patch a tuning param to allow faster scale up — will do a hotfix deploy to infra-config canary in 25m. If revert doesn't stabilize, we'll force scale.
eng-oncall: Revert started. Watching tail of logs: `kubectl rollout status deploy/inference  -n prod` shows 3/3 updated in 60s. Sending smoke requests to FinSparc tenant now.
eng-oncall: Smoke run: p95 down from 1.2s -> 380ms for sample endpoints. Initial telemetry looks good.
customer-success-liz: Passing to FinSparc. They report partial recovery but still see occasional 700-900ms spikes in EU region.
sre-sasha: EU cluster shows higher queue depth. Possibly KV cache warm-up after variant change. We should warm caches proactively: run a small prefix replay for FinSparc's top 20 prompts (~5m). Who can trigger?
ria-engr: I can run a targeted warmup job. Kicking off `python tools/warmup.py --tenant finsparc --top 20` now. ETA ~6m.
julien: Also, adding a temporary routing rule to prefer local region instances for EU to reduce cross-region latencies — small config change, 7m to roll. I can do it after warmup if spikes persist.
pm-alex: Great. Let's keep the timeline visible: revert applied (~10m), warmup (~6m), infra patch (25m). If EU spikes persist after warmup, julien to apply regional routing.
customer-success-liz: FinSparc wants official owner and ETA. I'll communicate: Owner: Engineering oncall (ria + sasha + infra-tom). ETA for stable baseline < 30m, full resolution 60-90m. They accepted a 60m SLA grace for now.
eng-oncall: Confirming we will follow up with a short incident note and postmortem if autoscaler bug is root cause. Adding `#postmortem-required` label.
pm-alex: Also need code-review ping: @julien please hold the KV eviction PR and add a test for scale logic. @ria-engr please add PR for revert rollback docs (one-liner) so CS has an audit trail.
julien: Will add test and mark WIP on PR.
sre-sasha: Monitoring — setting dashboard alert thresholds lower and watching for error rates. Will update thread in 15m with p95 trends.
infra-tom: Hotfix plan pushed to canary, starting rollout in 2m. Will escalate to full pool if revert/warmup don't fully resolve.
eng-oncall: Thanks all. Quick wins look promising. I'll post the final status when we have stabilized for 15m. :white_check_mark:
customer-success-liz: Thanks team — FinSparc appreciates the quick response, keeping them in the loop now.
pm-alex: After stabilization let's sync tomorrow for a short retro and to confirm autoscaler tuning change in staging.
eng-oncall: Final update: 15m steady state at p95 ~360ms for US, EU ~420ms. Closing urgent escalation; follow-ups: autoscaler bugfix, postmortem, PR holds.
sre-sasha: Noted. I'll open the postmortem draft and assign owners.
pm-alex: Closing thread here, extra kudos everyone. :tada:
